(a) Is f an increasing or decreasing function of:

A?

increasing
decreasing
neither increasing nor decreasing
somtimes increasing and sometimes decreasing

(b) Interpret the statement f(1000, 1.5, 26) \approx 1384 by writing a sentence, including units. Then use your sentence to complete the following:

months
dollars

p.em: (Note because this is all multiple choice, you will not see which parts of the problem are correct.)

static.solution:
(a) We expect B to be an increasing function of all three variables.
(b) A deposit of 1000 dollars at a 1.5 % annual interest rate for 26 months results in a balance of 1384 dollars.
